source.source_text: Purpose: bounded Accessibility-tree snapshot for an approved app/window. Input: app_id:string, window_hint?:string, max_nodes?:1..2000. Output: stable opaque element refs, roles, labels and safe states; secure nodes masked. Contract: L4 read_only; scope mac.ui.observe; target app_window; timeout 10000ms; cap 512KiB; no network/filesystem; secure UI/password content masked; approval trusted_gui; idempotent yes. Phase 4 planned.
